content: Letter 8, to Iskandar b. ʿUmar Shaykh (?) (ca. 816/1413, Isfahan or Shiraz): MK reads the addressee, a royal personage addressed with a benediction on the perfect sultanate, as presumably Iskandar, Ibn Turka's patron before Shāhrukh's first campaign in western Iran in 817/1414. The partially illegible opening line suggests the honorific Jamāl al-Dīn (TMN/MS pp. 4-5).
